traffic.scope: Four watched starting points; 240 simulated seconds per point; seed 1
hotspots: Kajaaninkatu / Kirkkokatu near the Cathedral: bus queues, signals and following traffic
Kaarlenvayla near the theatre: a road blockage propagates through following traffic
Rantakatu: a bus stops making progress

visual: No central street has yet passed the guide's photo-by-photo appearance review.

Market Hall has a bespoke procedural model; exact ornament, proportions, unseen elevations and surrounding market buildings remain provisional. Toripolliisi reconstruction and collision are excluded pending artwork permission; see HANDOVER.md.
Valkea shopping centre has no completed dedicated, reference-validated landmark treatment. Mapped shells, if present, remain provisional; validate the complex and entrances before modelling.

Cathedral now has a bespoke model: curved roofs/dome, staged tower, four clocks, square spire, ball/cross, columned entrance and terrain-supported stairs. Fine profiles, clock numerals, side/rear details and churchyard need validation.
City Hall now has a municipal-height, twin-pavilion bespoke model, entrance stairs, lamps and benches. Fine relief, side/rear details and full garden reconstruction remain provisional.

Theatre and Library Saari now use municipal LOD1 shells and photo-guided facade additions. Entrance glazing and colonnades have CC0 photo guidance; lettering, steps, current quay/garden and exact facade/interior details remain incomplete; railway station remains provisional.
Most building heights remain estimates. Municipal tile 212221 now supplies the theatre/library LOD1 shell heights; these are legacy data, not current detailed roof measurements.
Contributor-photo-backed pink bus paint, single windscreen, round front lights and plain operator lettering are implemented; full body shape and the rest of the fleet remain provisional.
City Hall has a documented municipal LOD1 height reference and photo-guided facade/roof additions; detailed heights and profiles remain estimates. Isokatu 37 still has colour/material-only guidance.
